secrets.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Google service account email (Cloud Console → IAM → Service Accounts) with the Sheets API enabled; share the spreadsheet with it as Editor.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Private key of that service account (the full -----BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY----- block from the JSON key file).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SHEET_ID
secrets.description: ID of the Google Sheet used as the database (the long string in the sheet URL between /d/ and /edit).

secrets.name: IMGBB_API_KEY
secrets.description: imgbb API key for image uploads — get one free at https://api.imgbb.com/

secrets.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
secrets.description: Email used to log in to the /admin panel.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH
secrets.description: bcrypt hash of the admin password — generate with: npx bcryptjs-cli hash "your-password" 10

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Long random string used to sign admin session JWTs — generate with: openssl rand -base64 48
